task.cue_positions: All eight row-major positions except output(2,2)
task.population: Complete census of six labels by eight positions per delay; no novel content/generalization claim.

interventions.state_boundary: After cue and all gap frames, immediately before addition/processing of identical query
interventions.zero: Zero retained state or GRU hidden state; preserve query, weights, delay and all tensor/runtime settings.
interventions.swap: Cyclic donor label within same cue position; record original target and donor target. Both natural stored states.

interference.distractor_labels: All six answers independently crossed with target and cue position
conditions: next of eight cue positions cyclically
interference.blank_control: Same48label-positionpredictions repeated across6independentdistractors or equivalently labelledbalancedcensus

estimands.within_family: delay8-minus-delay2 pairedaccuracy; descriptive unless explicitly frozen as secondary
